description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the Accuracy@1 on geometry problems and tree width for rollout search. The x-axis is labeled "Num. of Child Nodes (Tree Width)" with a linear scale, ranging from 1 to 7, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy@1 (%)", also with a linear scale, spanning from 15 to 35, with tick labels at intervals of 5. Two lines are shown: a blue dashed line representing GPT-4o, and a blue solid line representing Claude-3.5-Sonnet. The GPT-4o line starts at 24.4% and increases to 28.9% at a tree width of 3, then rises to 34.4% at a tree width of 5 before decreasing to 31.1% at a tree width of 7. The Claude-3.5-Sonnet line begins at 26.7%, remains steady at 27.8% at a tree width of 3, then drops to 24.4% at a tree width of 5 and further decreases to 20.0% at a tree width of 7.
